faq.q: How do I export my resume as a PDF?
faq.a: Go to your resume editor, then click the “Download PDF” button in the top right. The file will be generated instantly with the exact same layout as your preview.

faq.q: Can I change the template afterward?
faq.a: Absolutely! You can change the template at any time from the editor without losing your information. All your content will be automatically adapted to the new design.
Yes, all your data is encrypted and securely stored. We comply with GDPR and never share your information with third parties.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Contact us through this form with the subject “Account Deletion” and we will process your request within 48 hours, in accordance with your GDPR rights.

sections.title: 1. Data collection
sections.content: As part of using CVBuilder, we collect the following personal data: first name, last name, email address, phone number, postal address, and professional and academic information entered in resumes.

sections.title: 2. Purposes of processing
sections.content: The collected data is used for:
list: Creating and managing your user account
Improving our services and user experience
Sending communications related to the service

sections.title: 3. Legal basis
sections.content: The processing of your data is based on contract performance (provision of the service) and, where applicable, your consent for marketing communications.

sections.title: 4. Retention period
sections.content: Your personal data is retained for the entire duration of your registration and for 3 years after the last activity on your account. Beyond that, your data will be deleted or anonymized.

sections.title: 5. Data sharing
sections.content: Your data is not sold to third parties. It may be shared with our technical processors (hosting, infrastructure) strictly for the purpose of providing the service, and in compliance with GDPR.

sections.title: 6. Security
sections.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against any unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.content: In accordance with GDPR, you have the following rights:

rights.label: Right of access
rights.desc: Obtain a copy of your personal data

rights.label: Right to erasure
rights.desc: Request the deletion of your data

rights.label: Right to portability
rights.desc: Receive your data in a structured format

rights.label: Right to object
rights.desc: Object to the processing of your data

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.content: CVBuilder uses cookies that are strictly necessary for the operation of the service (authentication, preferences). No advertising cookies are used without your explicit consent.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.content: For any questions regarding the protection of your data, you can write to us at contact@cvbuilder.fr or via our contact page.

privacy.ctaDescription: Contact our data protection officer for any request related to your GDPR rights.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.content: These Terms and Conditions of Sale (T&Cs) govern the contractual relationship between CVBuilder (hereinafter the “Service”) and any individual or legal entity (hereinafter the “User”) wishing to use the services offered on the website cvbuilder.fr.

sections.title: 2. Services offered
sections.content: CVBuilder offers an online service for creating, editing, and downloading resumes. Features include entering personal information, choosing templates, graphic customization, and exporting in PDF format.

sections.title: 3. Registration and user account
sections.content: Access to the services requires the creation of an account. The User agrees to provide accurate information and to maintain the confidentiality of their login credentials. Any use of the account is deemed to have been carried out by the User.

sections.title: 4. Pricing and payment
sections.content: Service prices are indicated in euros, all taxes included (TTC). Payment is made online using the payment methods accepted on the platform. CVBuilder reserves the right to modify its prices at any time, with the new pricing conditions applying to orders placed after the modification.

sections.title: 5. Right of withdrawal
sections.content: In accordance with Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, the right of withdrawal cannot be exercised for contracts for the supply of digital content not provided on a tangible medium, the performance of which has begun with the consumer’s prior express agreement.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual property
sections.content: All elements of the website (design, texts, images, software) are protected by intellectual property law. Resumes created by users remain their property. CVBuilder retains ownership of its templates and technology.

sections.title: 7. Liability
sections.content: CVBuilder undertakes to use all necessary means to ensure the continuity and quality of the service. However, CVBuilder cannot be held liable for service interruptions, data loss, or any indirect damage resulting from the use of the service.

sections.title: 8. Termination
sections.content: The User may terminate their account at any time from their personal space. CVBuilder reserves the right to suspend or terminate an account in the event of a breach of these T&Cs.

sections.title: 9. Governing law
sections.content: These T&Cs are governed by French law. Any dispute relating to their interpretation or execution falls under the jurisdiction of the French courts.
